description: Revoke an API key. this_key true revokes the key this server uses and forgets it. For another key, pass its id (from list_keys) and the emailed code; with no code it emails one. Closing the account is not possible here: the user does that in the dashboard. Free.

this_key.description: True to revoke the key this server uses.

name: revoke_key
title: Revoke an API key
